decisions.reason: The accelerator program is cheap to keep running but sits far from the core recycling machinery business, and the firm has several other options competing for attention, so its value is uncertain but not yet clearly resolved against it.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship whose market value is still highly uncertain, so the option is worth keeping while it costs relatively little, even though it is distant from the core and could be cut if early demand fails.

The infectious waste plant is a flagship close to the core offer, developed with a partner (ERMAFA) that shares the cost, and it has no negative signals yet, so keeping the option open is clearly worthwhile.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the decentralized WASTX line closely and costs little to keep as an extension of existing know-how, and its uncertainty has not resolved negatively.
